tour.title: Project Overview & Entry Point
tour.description: Welcome to the AI Core module! This project provides integrated AI capabilities for metaphysical applications. Start with lib/ai_core.dart, the main library entry point, and lib/utils/ai_bootstrap.dart, which handles the initialization of services and database seeding.

tour.title: Core Services: LLM & Agent Orchestration
tour.description: Explore the brain of the system. AiService (lib/services/ai_service.dart) provides the high-level API for sessions and personas. LlmService manages multi-provider adapters (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic), while AgentOrchestrator handles recursive agent calls and multi-agent collaboration.

tour.title: User Interface: Chat Experience & Persona Management
tour.description: The presentation layer brings AI to life. AiChatView (lib/widgets/ai_chat_view.dart) is the main interactive component. AiPersonaEditor allows for deep configuration of AI virtual characters, and AiChatSettingsDialog enables runtime adjustments of providers and models.

tour.title: Data Persistence & Audit Trail
tour.description: Reliability through persistence. AiDatabase (lib/database/ai_database.dart) manages 14 tables using the Drift ORM. Dedicated DAOs handle everything from chat history (AiChatMessagesDao) to immutable provenance chains and usage audits for token tracking.
